test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 8.4 cm is melted and recast into a cone of height 18.9 cm. What is the radius (in cm) of the base of the cone?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the sphere = 8.4 cm

Height of the cone = 18.9 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = (πR²h)/3

Volume of sphere = (4πr³)/3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e1717efc210ef81e097c845450f890bdb16ca48b6b663556d1d09a5bb86ac1f.png] 

According to the question,

(4π × 8.4³)/3 = (πr² × 18.9)/3

⇒ 4 × 8.4³/18.9 = r²

⇒ (4 × 8.4 × 8.4 × 8.4)/18.9 = r2

⇒ 125.44 = r2

⇒ 11.2 = r

**∴ The radius of the base of the cone is 11.2 cm**
